Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare, Dezvoltare de software și Bănci
Lead QA Automation Engineer | Playwright, C#, CI/CD | Global Payments & Banking Company Building Its Own QA Function 
Salary: RON 300,000 - 360,000 gross per year (RON 25,000 - 30,000 gross per month).
Location: Bucharest, hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 from home
Employment: via a local payroll partner until the company's Romanian entity is set up
 Our long-standing client, an international payments and banking group, is building its own QA function in Bucharest from scratch and wants a Lead QA Automation Engineer in first to shape it. You’ll be the first hire in a team of around nine automation engineers.
 You’ll report to the Head of QA, with a dotted line to the Bucharest site lead. It’s an architect-level role with no line management. Their automation runs in silos across five to ten internal and external systems, and you’ll design the framework that brings it together while staying hands-on in Playwright. C#/.NET is their preference, though they’ll consider strong Python or Java engineers too.
 Non-Negotiables 
Financial services: payments, SWIFT, banking
Test automation framework design across integrated systems
Playwright
C#/.NET (Python or Java considered)
SDET background, hands-on coding
CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
API testing: REST, contract, schema
 What You'll Work With 
C#/.Net, with some TypeScript
Kafka and Azure Service Bus
Azure Application Insights, KQL 
Kubernetes (K8s), Docker
IaC: Terraform
Web apps and legacy Windows desktop apps
GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry
TestRail, Jira
 Nice to Haves 
MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors
AI in testing: agentic workflows, LLM evaluation
Load testing at high transaction volumes: k6, Artillery, LoadRunner
Service virtualisation, mocks, stubs
Azure (AWS also fine)
BDD: Gherkin, SpecFlow, Cucumber
Core banking platforms
 Why Join / Projects 
 We've worked with this client for several years and placed people across their tech teams. They're an international business with a strong reputation in payments, and this is one of the more interesting builds we're recruiting for in Bucharest.
You’re building the function rather than inheriting one. You’ll set the framework and the standards, and help shape the culture of a growing tech hub.
You’ll design a test pyramid weighted towards fast API, contract and integration checks, with quality built in from discovery through to production verification.
You’ll create one framework and centre of excellence across both sides of the business, payments and banking, so you see the whole estate rather than one product.
They’re building a template for agentic engineering across the software lifecycle, with QA as one of its pillars. You’ll help decide where AI fits into testing.
 Employee Benefits 
25 days' holiday plus Romanian public holidays
Extra day off in your birthday month
Private medical cover 
Annual salary review
Support for training and study
Long service awards 
 If you've built test automation in financial services and want to set up a QA function from the ground floor, apply and I'll give you a call.
